surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
SOURCE: tar_path archive and its member entries, including embedded file paths and symlink/hardlink targets; dest_path.
TRUST: All archive contents and member metadata are untrusted external input; dest_path is the trusted boundary.
SINK: Directories, regular files, symbolic links, and hard links created under dest_path.
GUARD: Normalize every member path and link target against dest_path and reject escapes; archive extraction may create symbolic-link and hard-link members only when each normalized link target remains inside the destination. Validate every member and link before extracting any archive content.
ORDER: First, fully iterate all members to validate paths and link targets; only then proceed to extract any archive content.
EFFECT: Return True if all members are extracted successfully beneath dest_path; return False and do not write any archive member outside dest_path if validation or extraction fails.
END_PLAN
